newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran in hydroelectric turbines deal with China.
newsitem.headline: Iran in hydroelectric turbines deal with China.

text.p: China has signed a deal with Iran to build turbines for Iranian hydroelectric plants, the Tehran Times newspaper said on Sunday.
It did not say when the work would start or how much the deal was worth. Chinese embassy officials could not be reached for comment.
Iran and China have in the past year signed contracts worth millions of dollars for several projects including mining and transport. Iran has also bought Chinese weapons and anti-ship missiles.
Iran in November denied U.S. media reports that it recently purchased from China missile technology and chemicals used to produce nerve gas.

The United States, which has imposed a trade ban on Iran, said last month it plans to probe new allegations Beijing may have violated commitments or laws designed to curb certain transactions with Iran.
